consumes.A: INTERFACE_A A.2 @abddeb73: candidate_receipt v1 rows; role = C1 MANAGEMENT|ENTRY (refused otherwise), additive c2_role and support_sha256 kept in report tags; outer-week split=VALIDATION rows for WEEKLY_REFIT units (fold W<week>)
consumes.B: calls the publisher API below when a candidate reaches a terminal disposition (COMPLETE or not); B's scheduler is not modified by D
consumes.E: INTERFACE_E E.1 @3b62fdb0: effective_config_sha256 = sha256(json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")) of the evaluator request config; search_candidate_sha256 = sha256(canonical {plan_sha256, horizon_hours, genotype_canonical_sha256}); both re-verified by D
consumes.C: INTERFACE_C C.2: fold ids 2023Q1..2023Q4, 2023Q1_DCA..2023Q3_DCA and W<week_id>; VALIDATION rows only on W<week> folds (VALIDATION_ON_INNER_FOLD otherwise); fold ids naming 2025 or TEST refused

record_candidate.effect: validates, builds canonical body bytes (content-addressed), writes one outbox item; state LOCAL_COMPLETE. Idempotent: same body -> same item_id, no new row. Never trains, never touches the scheduler. Row keys are checked against everything already recorded: a row key bound to different content is refused at record time (ROW_KEY_CONFLICT), never discovered at the ETL.

returns.states: {LOCAL_COMPLETE, OBJECT_DURABLE, CHAIN_FINALIZED, OLAP_READBACK_VERIFIED} each null or an evidence object

publisher_api.pump: publisher.pump(archive: doin_node.archive.external.ExternalPayloadArchive, submit: callable(Transaction)) -> {stored, submitted, errors}. external_payload: PUT body+manifest, GET exact, digest compare -> OBJECT_DURABLE; only then the reference tx (timestamp fixed at record time => same tx id on replay) goes to submit. Failed PUT/GET => LOCAL_COMPLETE only, nothing submitted.
publisher_api.etl: tools.i6n_archive.etl.ArchiveETL(outbox, stores, sink, confirmation_depth).run(chain_blocks) -> dict: verifies chain links, finality, reference tx id binding, bytes, digests, schema; projects into the warehouse; reads back; then marks CHAIN_FINALIZED and OLAP_READBACK_VERIFIED (ACK). Reorg: canonical projection revoked by an appended event, history kept. Incremental: (tx_id, block_hash) pairs already read back are skipped (etl_done watermark), so work is proportional to new references; a reorg forgets the watermark of revoked blocks. D.4: ArchiveETL.run_offchain() projects durable, spooled, hash-reverified bodies with finality_state OFFCHAIN_VERIFIED (block NO_BLOCK, chain_finalized=false); a FINALIZED projection later supersedes it (event SUPERSEDED), never duplicates it.
publisher_api.status: publisher.status() -> {items, per_state_counts, green (all four states), missing: [...]} ; read-only
publisher_api.submit_to_node: CLI pump writes <spool>/<tx_id>.json (exclusive create, identical replay is a no-op); the node calls doin_node.archive.external.ingest_reference_spool(spool, consensus.record_transaction, known_tx_ids=...) which re-derives the id and checks the reference before consensus sees it (B wires this hook in the runtime)

document.supersedes_decision_sha256: body digest of the previous decision or null
document.outcomes: [{search_candidate_sha256, outcome: WINNER|FINALIST|CONTROL|NOT_SELECTED}], at most one WINNER

record_decision.effect: append-only decision event; own body, reference and projection rows (fold DECISION-<seq>, role DECISION, split SEARCH, metric SEARCH_OUTCOME, metrics won/selected); view gov_doin_candidate_decision_current gives the latest decision per (experiment, h)

publisher_api.deploy_checks: python -m tools.i6n_archive.probe {lake|warehouse} --url .. --token-env NAME, run only via systemd-run --user -p EnvironmentFile=<existing env file>; never reads a token file
publisher_api.lifecycle: python -m tools.i6n_archive.lifecycle --campaign-root <root> [--status-json <B status>] [--write]: fold QUEUED/CLAIMED/UPDATING/COMPLETED/FAILED/INTERRUPTED, candidate NOT_RECORDED/LOCAL_COMPLETE/ARCHIVED/READBACK_VERIFIED, chain_finalized separate, ETA kind+basis_n (unknown without samples)

required.search_candidate_sha256: sha256: E search_candidate_sha256(g, plan_sha256); D verifies
required.plan_sha256: sha256 of the versioned plan JSON (E)
required.effective_config: object: E evaluator_config(g) (A request.config); D verifies effective_config_sha256 with E formula
required.effective_config_sha256: sha256 of canonical effective_config (verified by D)
required.fitness: number for COMPLETE/ADOPTED_CACHE only; null otherwise (never an invented score)
required.attempts: [{fold:str, index:1..3, state:str, parent_status_sha256:sha256|null, fencing_token:str|null, reason:str|null}] (max 3 per fold)
required.costs: object of finite numbers or null (elapsed_seconds, fit_seconds, peak_rss_bytes, ...)

forbidden.won: WON_IS_A_DECISION_EVENT: the search outcome is not a field of the candidate record

candidate_document.attempts: all physical attempts of one identity/fold may be passed as separate fold receipts (max 3, attempt.index unique, index>1 needs parent_status_sha256 per A.2, same candidate_identity_sha256); the canonical scientific measurement is the lowest attempt index; the others stay in the body and in the candidate row tag attempt_history_json, never projected as metrics

fold_receipt: A's candidate_receipt (i6n.candidate_receipt.v1) unchanged; rows with split TEST or a 2025+ fold are refused

derived_metrics_per_receipt_row.skill_mae: RATIO (only when naive_mae>0; undefined otherwise, never zero)

projection.idempotency_key: sha256(canonical(row identity with derived metric/unit)) + block_hash + finality_state
projection.warehouse: gov_report/gov_metric (one report per receipt row; gov_metric.horizon = head_offset_hours) + additive gov_doin_projection, gov_doin_projection_event, view gov_doin_metric_canonical (doin metadata schema i6n.doin_projection.v1)

candidate_level_row.metrics: attempts_total, fitness (RATIO, only when scored), cost.<name>; won moved to decision rows
candidate_level_row.tags: disposition, lineage (generation, population_index, operator, parents_json), genotype_json, effective_config_json, plan_metadata_json, attempts_json, seed, attempt_history_json

projection.receipt_rows_phase: I6N_SWARM_DOIN (decision rows: I6N_SWARM_DOIN_DECISION; candidate rows: I6N_SWARM_DOIN_CANDIDATE)
projection.report_identity: report carries no block hash, archive mode or locator: full and external, or two blocks, give ONE report_sha256

archive.body: doin.external_payload_body.v1 (doin-core doin_core.archive.external): canonical UTF-8 JSON {schema, domain_id, producer_peer_id, payload_schema, payload}; contains no manifest digest and no block hash
archive.manifest: doin.external_payload_manifest.v1: {schema, body_digest, body_size, body_schema, payload_schema, domain_id}
archive.reference_tx: CANDIDATE_EVALUATED transaction payload doin.external_payload_ref.v1 {archive_mode, body_digest, manifest_digest, body_size, payload_schema, locator} (external) or the same plus body (full_payload); tx.id must equal compute_id
archive.hash_identities: body_digest = sha256(body bytes); manifest_digest = sha256(manifest bytes); block hash = header hash. Three distinct values, none an input of its own computation.

state_rule: each state is set only by the step that verified it; a missing state is never reported green
